newsitem.title: FINLAND: MYLLYKOSKI ISSUES FIM 150 MLN DEBENTURE LOAN.
newsitem.headline: MYLLYKOSKI ISSUES FIM 150 MLN DEBENTURE LOAN.

text.p: Finnish privately owned forest industry group Myllykoski Oy said in a statement on Monday it would issue a 150 million markka 10-year debenture loan to its shareholders, personnel and institutional investors.

"The interest rate on the loan will be 9.00 percent p.a. paid annually as long as the loan amount does not exceed the free shareholders equity in Myllykoski Oy's balance sheet and in the consolidated balance sheet," it said.
The capital will be repaid after ten years provided that Myllykoski then fully covers its restricted shareholders equity, it said.
If the condition is not met, the loan will become linked to the 12-month Helibor rate, one year at a time, Myllykoski said.
The subscription period is October 7 to October 25, it said.
Myllykoski said it will apply for a listing of the loan on the Helsinki Stock Exchange after the subscription period.
